name: KyPulse
description: Health checks, alerts and an audit log for your Ky Suite and other apps.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the session key (session.key, made on first start) and initial-admin-password until you delete it. Back up the whole folder.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Sealed backup capsules. KyPulse makes them (daily) only after you pair it with KyRecovery or add a recovery key on the Backup page.

paths.name: Secrets
paths.description: The audit key (audit.key, made on first start) that signs the audit log. Back it up with the data folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyPulse web app, published on host as 6878. Plain http, for your https reverse proxy to point at: sign-in only works through the proxy's https address.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KYPULSE_APP_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace https://pulse.example.com with the https address of your reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) that points at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6878. KyPulse needs https to sign in: its sign-in check only runs on an https page. It must be the exact address you open in the browser.

variables.name: KYPULSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first password of the admin account. Leave it empty to have one made for you: it is shown in the app's logs (CREDENTIALS) and saved as initial-admin-password in the data folder. Change it after your first sign-in.
